BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the Nordic Heritage Museum; and adding a newsection to chapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Nordic Heritage Museum in Seattle is hereby designated as theofficial Nordic museum of the state of Washington.
